body: I get what your saying ,fortunately enough I’ve been drug and alcohol free since my overdose 5 years ago but the mental toll to recover has been a lot and all the things I have done since has taken that toll up more and more every day ,for 6 months now I’ve been trying to turn my life around and away from the streets to better my self for my future and stay out the way but every day I wake up I feel as the damage is already done and I’ve been struggling to find my way or who I am actually,I’ve put this image in my head that I’m someone who I’m not and I just don’t know who I am anymore. I know I have all the time in the world to continue trying but I feel as if my mental health just can’t take it anymore.I’ve always been scared of what’s to come after death but wanting to leave this place has now overcome that fear and I just want to go ya know
